# archestra_team (Data Source)

Fetches an Archestra team by `id` or by its exact `name`. Set one of the two.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a team imported into the org outside Terraform — common when the team
# was created via the UI but you want to scope a TF-managed resource onto it.
data "archestra_team" "engineering" {
  id = var.engineering_team_id
}

# Use the team's id to scope an LLM provider key onto it.
resource "archestra_model_provider" "engineering_anthropic" {
  name         = "Engineering Anthropic Key"
  api_key      = var.anthropic_key
  llm_provider = "anthropic"
}

output "team_name" {
  value = data.archestra_team.engineering.name
}

# Members are surfaced as a list of { user_id, role } objects — useful for
# audit reports or for cross-checking that LDAP sync ran.
output "team_admins" {
  value = [for m in data.archestra_team.engineering.members : m.user_id if m.role == "admin"]
}

# A team can also be found by its exact name, when its ID is not at hand.
data "archestra_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Team identifier. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) The name of the team. Set it to find the team by its exact name instead of by `id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) User ID of the team creator
- `description` (String) Description of the team
- `external_group_ids` (Set of String) SSO groups mapped to this team, when visible and Team Sync is available.
- `members` (Attributes List) List of team members (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID this team belongs to

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `role` (String) Role of the team member
- `user_id` (String) User ID of the team member
